notes: The counted references array intentionally contains only COMPLETE eligible custom-geometry skins. Discovery-only candidates are staged separately and do not open production. Mega/Gmax/canonical forms, shiny/recolor-only variants and ordinary canonical remodels do not count.

discoveryEvidence: The project describes itself as adding costumes for Cobblemon Pokemon and explicitly lists Gengar [Overtime].
The 3.1.1 changelog explicitly says ADDED Overtime Gengar; 3.1.1.1 is the resolver-fix release of the same 208.71 KiB package.
Public project metadata is sufficient to establish a real custom-costume candidate, but not to prove the model geometry or texture implementation.
candidateReferences.whyNotCounted: The actual Overtime Gengar MODEL and TEXTURE files have not been opened and SHA-256 hashed. Geometry change therefore remains unproven.
licenseEvidence: Modrinth currently labels the project MIT.
CurseForge currently labels the project All Rights Reserved.
candidateReferences.reuseReason: Do not promote to derivative donor until the exact downloaded package contains a compatible license/provenance grant and the relevant asset files are verified.

discoveryEvidence: The public Sketchfab entry is explicitly titled Galaxy Gengar (Cobblemon), describes Galaxy themed Gengar and Mega Gengar, and says the original Gengar model came from Cobblemon.
The public 3D entry reports roughly 1.7k triangles and 1.1k vertices and states that it was uploaded with Blockbench.

Parkball Gang independently documents a Galaxy Gengar cosmetic Pokemon skin in its Galaxy crate, but this dossier does not assume the Sketchfab asset and server asset are byte-identical without file provenance.
candidateReferences.whyNotCounted: An interactive 3D presentation is stronger than a screenshot but does not expose the actual MODEL + TEXTURE source files needed for direct inspection and SHA-256 hashing. Geometry change versus texture-only treatment is not yet proven from source files.
candidateReferences.reuseReason: Viewer inspection may guide high-level technique only. Do not copy or redistribute model/texture bytes without an explicit compatible license.

discoveryEvidence: The public 3D entry explicitly lists a Halloween themed Gengar alongside Trevenant, Cofagrigus and Noivern.
The entry states that the original models came from the Cobblemon Minecraft mod and exposes an interactive 3D presentation rather than a screenshot-only gallery.
The combined four-Pokemon presentation reports roughly 5.7k triangles and 3.8k vertices, but that aggregate count cannot prove Gengar-specific geometry changes.
candidateReferences.whyNotCounted: The underlying Gengar MODEL and TEXTURE files are not exposed for direct inspection in the public viewer, so exact geometry delta, UV treatment and texture SHA-256 cannot be verified.
candidateReferences.reuseReason: Study the public presentation only; do not copy or redistribute model/texture bytes without an explicit compatible license.

discoveryLeads.evidence: Parkball Gang lists Gengar among its Summer Crate cosmetic Pokemon skins.
discoveryLeads.blocker: No publicly inspectable Gengar Summer MODEL + TEXTURE asset set was located in this run.

discoveryLeads.evidence: Public changelog mentions Halloween skins involving Gengar.
discoveryLeads.blocker: No public production model/texture source was found and the changelog also references Mega Halloween skins, so base-Gengar eligibility must not be assumed.

discoveryLeads.evidence: PokeResort exposes a Blockbench-uploaded Gengar Staff Shiny 3D presentation.
discoveryLeads.blocker: The title includes Shiny and no non-shiny staff asset or source MODEL + TEXTURE files were verified, so it cannot be treated as an eligible custom-geometry skin yet.

rejectedReferences.reason: INVALID_REFERENCE_CLASS: ordinary canonical Gengar remodel/accuracy edit, not a distinct themed custom skin.
INVALID_REFERENCE_CLASS: shiny/texture redesign. Texture-only or shiny references never count toward the three custom-geometry skins.
INVALID_REFERENCE_CLASS: Mega Gengar is a canonical Pokemon transformation/form, not a Gengar skin reference.
INVALID_REFERENCE_CLASS: Gigantamax Gengar is a canonical Pokemon form, not a Gengar skin reference.
ELIGIBILITY_UNPROVEN: may be reconsidered only if real assets prove a non-canonical themed skin with materially changed geometry; a palette/form label alone does not count.

nextAction: Obtain and directly inspect actual MODEL + TEXTURE files for Overtime Gengar first; then either obtain source files for Galaxy/Halloween Gengar or replace them with equally strong downloadable custom-geometry Gengar skins. No Rift Warden production generation is allowed before three references move into references[] as COMPLETE.
